title: Figentra Deployable Modules Array
description: Validates the modules[] array inside a deployable cloud.yaml. Each entry references a module from the infrastructure/modules/ registry by name, pins a semver range, and supplies typed config that the registry module schema validates.

use.description: Module name — must match a folder under infrastructure/modules/.

config.description: Module-specific configuration. Validated against the module schema at catalog-collection time.
